notes.title: September Updates - New Demo!
notes.notes: [p]Happy September! This month I've been working on a brand new demo build for Mari's Magical Deliveries, as the old one was lacking in a lot of the features and artwork for the final game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/0aa650b96d405293bc9856dfed6c5b1b47393a3d.png"][/img][/p][p]This new demo showcases the new character artwork, various GUI improvements, and most importantly...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/1b439074fbd6efac2dc505dfd5eb68b3e867f93d.png"][/img][/p][p]...the delivery mechanics! They're finally able to be seen in the demo. While the current demo doesn't allow you to customize which packages you want to take, the full game will allow you to pick and choose which to deliver - and in turn, which love interests you'll want to spend time with.[/p][p]The map system also got an overhaul to be more readable.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/ead595478d1477f97c5097cace66949484fec8f0.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you everyone who checked out the demo beforehand![/p][p][/p][p]Next week we'll be in the Fall in Love Romance Visual Novel Festival, a festival dedicated to romance-themed visual novels! Be sure to check it out when it starts on September 24th~[/p][p][/p][p]— Arimia[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://mailchi.mp/4e122e9a1446/cgw-newsletter"]get our newsletter[/url]  ♥  [url="https://discord.gg/vE2Yng4"]join our discord[/url]  ♥  [url="https://crystalgameworks.com/devlogs/"]read other devlogs[/url][/p]

notes.title: August Updates – New Art
notes.notes: [p]August has been a busy month—the Kickstarter for [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cgw/crimson-waves-on-the-emerald-sea-amaranthine-moon/"]Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon[/url] is nearing the end and we’ve made a lot of progress across different games. Today I wanted to show some of that for Mari’s Magical Deliveries, a game jam proof of concept that we’re finishing this year.[/p][p][/p][h2]Make Deliveries to Fall in Love[/h2][p]In Mari’s Magical Deliveries, you play as Mari, a college aged witch. The previous key arts all had Mari somewhat obscured, looking over the town, but the new key art shows her fully.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/fc1ba00410fb95051eea65f1ab27ca1aedb2ba85.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The plot revolves around Mari helping her father’s delivery business. He now has a brand new sprite, to better match the rest of the cast.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/d42e68c11330e5c7f740fbbc25024103ae33f781.png"][/img][/p][p]You’ll get to pick which deliveries you make, with 3 of the return customers being her love interests. The delivery screen is almost done and this is what it looks like, with new character and icon artworks.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/f3196d9f08bd0f3d4dea81f5d46db1f45f965617.png"][/img][/p][h2]Meet Lots of Side Characters[/h2][p]Alongside delivering packages to potential love interests, there’s a lot of side characters for Mari to meet as well! We showed off a few of the side characters in the previous [url="https://crystalgameworks.com/may-2025-maris-magical-deliveries/"]May devlog[/url] on the game, so here’s a couple more that have recently been worked on.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/461c7726d88367a8959620ed2fb2bf345c92a46e.png"][/img][/p][p]There’s still a couple more side characters to meet in the game, which we’ll show off at a later date once they’re ready to be shown.[/p][p]Be sure to wishlist the game here on Steam![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3563380/Maris_Magical_Deliveries"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/48582d058394345315d123ba7d6c6452e73f8aac.png"][/img][/p][h2]follow us on...[/h2][p][url="https://discord.gg/vE2Yng4"]Discord[/url]  -  [url="https://bsky.app/profile/crystalgameworks.com"]Bluesky[/url]  -  [url="https://mailchi.mp/4e122e9a1446/cgw-newsletter"]Newsletter[/url][/p]

notes.title: May Updates – Mari’s Magical Deliveries
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/e0d3cca04bc81f16475a13162ace5b74f4e7e018.png[/img]

Mari’s Magical Deliveries was a game demo released a couple of years ago for Ludum Dare, being a point-and-click otome game about a witch moving back home and reconnecting with 3 old friends. Since then, the game has been worked on in the background, with a new demo coming out…next week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/0f76414dd275838ac2e2ea65b225d20c2b4c1941.png[/img]

This new demo will including some GUI improvements as well as new art, like the brand new character art for Castor, one of the three love interests. More character art improvements will be in the full release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/40a468b78beb5c8496a75eeb9c0b43eafa7e3012.jpg[/img]

There will also be a whole cast of side characters in the full game, such as these lovely girls, Kairina and Almyra! Kairina (left) is a part-time magician at the carnival while Almyra (right) is a vampire. Mari will make deliveries to the side characters, befriend them, and see how their lives intertwine with her love interests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524774/e54ab758a68ae5c0b61d384c50657c295ce23b94.jpg[/img]

The full game will also have a delivery system, where you start off the day by picking which packages you want to deliver yourself (with Mari’s father delivering the rest) and spending time with love interests that way. I’ll be able to share more info on this system down the line, but the base mechanics are currently almost done.

Writing for the full game is also being worked on, with some new scenes already drafted. The full game will be centered on individual scenes that progress overall plot points, with each of the love interests having different overall narratives from each other and depending on which packages you deliver (i.e. who you talk to).

A release date for the full game hasn’t been decided yet, as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139260/Asphodelium/]Asphodelium[/url] will be our next release (June) with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/]Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon[/url] being after that (late 2025), so we’re estimating late 2025 or early 2026.

If you want to support development, please give the game a wishlist on Steam! Every wishlist helps us out greatly.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3563380/Maris_Magical_Deliveries/

— Arimia
